# Stock Wide `Array(Bool)` fixture

Generated by `scripts/generate_public_bool_array_fixture.sh` with the pinned
ClickHouse 26.7.1.1315 official build in a disposable local store. This
synthetic Wide part contains sorted `pk UInt64`, `plain Array(Bool)`, and
`maybe Array(Nullable(Bool))` columns. Stock `CHECK TABLE` returned success
before the part was copied into this fixture.

The 13 keys are `1, 2, 4, 6, 9, 11, 13, 17, 19, 21, 25, 31, 40`, stored in six
two-row marks and one one-row final mark. Inputs include empty arrays, both
Boolean values, mixed nullable values, and NULLs. The captured NULL child
slots are zero bytes; the separate nullable map distinguishes them from
non-NULL false values. The exact substreams are
`plain.size0`, `plain`, `maybe.size0`, `maybe.null`, and `maybe`. The child Bool
payload and nullable map each use one byte per flattened element. LZ4 data and
plain `.mrk2` marks include a sentinel record.

This fixture has the stock sparse-serialization setting enabled and an empty
`columns` list in `serialization.json`. `SHA256SUMS` pins every captured part
file. The generator checks stock version, schema, substream inventory, row
count, serializer metadata, and `CHECK TABLE` before copying. Scope is this
pinned build and schema; this is not evidence for other nested-type layouts.
